text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 22, 2026) for 383 Sherbourne Street

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order April 22, 2026 for 383 Sherbourne Street, Folder No. 26 148033 PRS 00 IV and in doing so granted an extension of time to September 30, 2026 subject to the appellant providing supplementary heating by September 1, 2026. 2. That the order for Folder No. 26 148033 PRS 00 IR be corrected to reflect the Folder No. 26 148033 PRS 00 IV.
